Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown

correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until

True def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(out), len(out[0])
    # Mark full-width and full-height monochrome non-background lines.
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if out[r][0] != 0 and all(v == out[r][0] for v in out[r])]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if out[0][c] != 0 and all(out[r][c] == out[0][c] for r in range(h))]
    for r in rows:
        out[r] = [2] * w
    for c in cols:
        for r in range(h):
            out[r][c] = 2
    return out
